title: 超導加速腔製作
subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器
summary: 以 TESLA 型 1.3 GHz 九腔鈮製超導加速腔為對象，從 BCS 表面電阻與 Q₀ = G/Rs 出發，走過高 RRR 鈮板、深拉與電子束焊、電解拋光與烘烤、2 K 垂直測試與頻率調諧，最後整合成低溫模組並交付驗收紀錄。
summaryEn: Using the TESLA-type 1.3 GHz nine-cell niobium cavity, start from BCS surface resistance and Q₀ = G/Rs, then follow high-RRR niobium sheet, deep drawing and electron-beam welding, electropolishing and baking, 2 K vertical testing and frequency tuning, and end with cryomodule integration and an acceptance record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」與「表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity" and "Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TESLA 型加速腔由九個橢圓形腔室以 π 模式串接，長度約 1.038 m，在 1.3 GHz 下建立沿軸的加速電場 E_acc。腔壁為鈮，臨界溫度 9.25 K，浸在 2 K 的超流氦中；壁面電流只在約 40 nm 的穿透深度內流動，表面電阻為奈歐姆等級，使品質因數 Q₀ 達 10¹⁰ 量級。系統邊界包括射頻功率耦合器、高階模耦合器、氦槽與調諧器；進入腔壁的功率全部變成 2 K 熱負載，而 2 K 製冷每瓦要花數百瓦電力，所以 Q₀ 是整個設計的經濟核心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A TESLA-type cavity chains nine elliptical cells in the π mode over about 1.038 m and builds the on-axis accelerating field E_acc at 1.3 GHz. The wall is niobium with a critical temperature of 9.25 K, immersed in 2 K superfluid helium; wall current flows only within the roughly 40 nm penetration depth, the surface resistance is at the nano-ohm level, and the quality factor Q₀ reaches the 10¹⁰ range. The system boundary includes the RF power coupler, higher-order-mode couplers, helium vessel and tuner; every watt dissipated in the wall becomes a 2 K heat load, and 2 K refrigeration costs several hundred watts of electricity per watt, so Q₀ is the economic core of the design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「超導加速腔製作」的「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「大型儀器：校正交班日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: mechanism and system boundary” in “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Large Instruments: Calibration Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity" is correct?
options: 超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。
TESLA 型加速腔由九個橢圓形腔室以 π 模式串接，長度約 1.038 m，在 1.3 GHz 下建立沿軸的加速電場 E_acc。
只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。
optionsEn: A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall.
A TESLA-type cavity chains nine elliptical cells in the π mode over about 1.038 m and builds the on-axis accelerating field E_acc at 1.3 GHz.
Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero.
quiz.explanation: TESLA 型加速腔由九個橢圓形腔室以 π 模式串接，長度約 1.038 m，在 1.3 GHz 下建立沿軸的加速電場 E_acc。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A TESLA-type cavity chains nine elliptical cells in the π mode over about 1.038 m and builds the on-axis accelerating field E_acc at 1.3 GHz. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。取 E_acc = 16 MV/m、L = 1.038 m（V = 16.6 MV）、R/Q = 1036 Ω、Q₀ = 2.7×10¹⁰：P = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/2.80×10¹³ ≈ 9.9 W（連續波）。若 Q₀ 只有 1×10¹⁰，同樣梯度下耗散升到約 27 W。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L. For E_acc = 16 MV/m, L = 1.038 m (V = 16.6 MV), R/Q = 1036 Ω and Q₀ = 2.7×10¹⁰: P = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/2.80×10¹³ ≈ 9.9 W in continuous-wave operation. With Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰ the same gradient dissipates about 27 W. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。取 E_acc = 16 MV/m、L = 1.038 m（V = 16.6 MV）、R/Q = 1036 Ω、Q₀ = 2.7×10¹⁰：P = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/2.80×10¹³ ≈ 9.9 W（連續波）。若 Q₀ 只有 1×10¹⁰，同樣梯度下耗散升到約 27 W。
knowledge.textEn: Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L. For E_acc = 16 MV/m, L = 1.038 m (V = 16.6 MV), R/Q = 1036 Ω and Q₀ = 2.7×10¹⁰: P = (1.66×10⁷)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.76×10¹⁴/2.80×10¹³ ≈ 9.9 W in continuous-wave operation. With Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰ the same gradient dissipates about 27 W.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity", which statement holds?
options: 焊接後只要把表面打磨光亮，射頻性能就會好。
鈮腔是剛性金屬，射頻場不可能改變它的形狀與頻率。
腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。
optionsEn: After welding, a mirror-bright mechanical polish is enough for good RF performance.
A niobium cavity is rigid metal, so the RF field cannot change its shape or frequency.
Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L.
quiz.explanation: 腔壁耗散功率 P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀]，其中 V = E_acc·L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wall dissipation is P = V²/[(R/Q)·Q₀] with V = E_acc·L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans. Cross-check calorimetrically from helium bath pressure and boil-off flow, require agreement within about 10%, then invert the formula to obtain Q₀. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把射頻耗散當成「可忽略的小量」而只按靜態熱負載設計低溫系統，實機在高梯度連續波運轉時 2 K 氦槽壓力無法維持，腔體被迫降梯度或脈衝化運轉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating RF dissipation as negligible and sizing the cryogenics only for static load leaves the 2 K bath unable to hold pressure at high-gradient CW operation, forcing the cavity to lower gradient or pulsed duty.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。
knowledge.textEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans. Cross-check calorimetrically from helium bath pressure and boil-off flow, require agreement within about 10%, then invert the formula to obtain Q₀.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity"?
options: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
垂直測試合格的腔，裝進模組後性能一定相同。
optionsEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module.
quiz.explanation: 在垂直測試架上以校正過的方向耦合器量前向、反射與穿透功率，穩態時 P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans；同時以氦槽壓力與蒸發流量做量熱法交叉比對，兩者差異應在 10% 以內，再把 P_diss 代回公式反算 Q₀。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On the vertical test stand measure forward, reflected and transmitted power with calibrated directional couplers; in steady state P_diss = P_fwd − P_refl − P_trans. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把射頻耗散當成「可忽略的小量」而只按靜態熱負載設計低溫系統，實機在高梯度連續波運轉時 2 K 氦槽壓力無法維持，腔體被迫降梯度或脈衝化運轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Treating RF dissipation as negligible and sizing the cryogenics only for static load leaves the 2 K bath unable to hold pressure at high-gradient CW operation, forcing the cavity to lower gradient or pulsed duty. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：系統邊界包括射頻功率耦合器、高階模耦合器、氦槽與調諧器；進入腔壁的功率全部變成 2 K 熱負載，而 2 K 製冷每瓦要花數百瓦電力，所以 Q₀ 是整個設計的經濟核心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The system boundary includes the RF power coupler, higher-order-mode couplers, helium vessel and tuner; every watt dissipated in the wall becomes a 2 K heat load, and 2 K refrigeration costs several hundred watts of electricity per watt, so Q₀ is the economic core of the design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超導腔沒有電阻，所以射頻功率不會在腔壁發熱。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A superconducting cavity has zero resistance, so RF power does not heat the wall." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把射頻耗散當成「可忽略的小量」而只按靜態熱負載設計低溫系統，實機在高梯度連續波運轉時 2 K 氦槽壓力無法維持，腔體被迫降梯度或脈衝化運轉。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超導腔的能量平衡與系統邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy balance and system boundary of an SRF cavity" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
把射頻耗散當成「可忽略的小量」而只按靜態熱負載設計低溫系統，實機在高梯度連續波運轉時 2 K 氦槽壓力無法維持，腔體被迫降梯度或脈衝化運轉。
只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Treating RF dissipation as negligible and sizing the cryogenics only for static load leaves the 2 K bath unable to hold pressure at high-gradient CW operation, forcing the cavity to lower gradient or pulsed duty.

quiz.explanationEn: Treating RF dissipation as negligible and sizing the cryogenics only for static load leaves the 2 K bath unable to hold pressure at high-gradient CW operation, forcing the cavity to lower gradient or pulsed duty. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」如何決定超導加速腔製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance” determines the key performance of “Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射頻場下超導體仍有耗散，因為未配對的準粒子在交變電場中被加速而碰撞。BCS 理論給出表面電阻 R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T)，其中 Δ 是能隙，鈮的 Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K；溫度越低、頻率越低，R_BCS 越小。實際表面電阻 R_s = R_BCS + R_res，殘餘電阻 R_res 來自捕獲磁通、氫化物析出與表面汙染，與溫度無關。品質因數 Q₀ = G/R_s，G 是只由腔形決定的幾何因子，TESLA 腔形 G ≈ 270 Ω。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A superconductor still dissipates under RF because unpaired quasiparticles are accelerated by the alternating field and scatter. BCS theory gives a surface resistance R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T), where Δ is the energy gap and for niobium Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K; lower temperature and lower frequency reduce R_BCS. The real surface resistance is R_s = R_BCS + R_res, where the residual term comes from trapped magnetic flux, hydride precipitation and surface contamination and does not depend on temperature. The quality factor is Q₀ = G/R_s, with G a geometry factor fixed only by the cell shape, about 270 Ω for the TESLA shape. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A common approximation is R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω with T in kelvin.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存
knowledge.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀
knowledge.text: 射頻場下超導體仍有耗散，因為未配對的準粒子在交變電場中被加速而碰撞。BCS 理論給出表面電阻 R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T)，其中 Δ 是能隙，鈮的 Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K；溫度越低、頻率越低，R_BCS 越小。
knowledge.textEn: A superconductor still dissipates under RF because unpaired quasiparticles are accelerated by the alternating field and scatter. BCS theory gives a surface resistance R_BCS ∝ (f²/T)·exp(−Δ/k_B T), where Δ is the energy gap and for niobium Δ/k_B ≈ 17.7 K; lower temperature and lower frequency reduce R_BCS.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀" is correct?
options: 只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。
鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。
射頻場下超導體仍有耗散，因為未配對的準粒子在交變電場中被加速而碰撞。
optionsEn: Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero.
Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature.
A superconductor still dissipates under RF because unpaired quasiparticles are accelerated by the alternating field and scatter.
quiz.explanation: 射頻場下超導體仍有耗散，因為未配對的準粒子在交變電場中被加速而碰撞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A superconductor still dissipates under RF because unpaired quasiparticles are accelerated by the alternating field and scatter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。在頻率 f = 1.3 GHz：溫度 T = 2.0 K 時 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.5×0.751×1.46×10⁻⁴ ≈ 11 nΩ；溫度 4.2 K 時 ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.238×0.751×0.0149 ≈ 530 nΩ。加上殘餘電阻 R_res = 5 nΩ，2 K 的總表面電阻 R_s ≈ 16 nΩ，品質因數 Q₀ = 270/16×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.7×10¹⁰；4.2 K 時 Q₀ 只剩約 5×10⁸。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A common approximation is R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω with T in kelvin. At f = 1.3 GHz: T = 2.0 K gives R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.5×0.751×1.46×10⁻⁴ ≈ 11 nΩ; T = 4.2 K gives ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.238×0.751×0.0149 ≈ 530 nΩ. Adding R_res = 5 nΩ, R_s at 2 K is ≈ 16 nΩ and Q₀ = 270/16×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.7×10¹⁰, while at 4.2 K Q₀ falls to about 5×10⁸. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res；再與材料與處理紀錄比對是否符合 ≤ 5 nΩ 的殘餘電阻目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。在頻率 f = 1.3 GHz：溫度 T = 2.0 K 時 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.5×0.751×1.46×10⁻⁴ ≈ 11 nΩ；溫度 4.2 K 時 ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.238×0.751×0.0149 ≈ 530 nΩ。加上殘餘電阻 R_res = 5 nΩ，2 K 的總表面電阻 R_s ≈ 16 nΩ，品質因數 Q₀ = 270/16×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.7×10¹⁰；4.2 K 時 Q₀ 只剩約 5×10⁸。
knowledge.textEn: A common approximation is R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω with T in kelvin. At f = 1.3 GHz: T = 2.0 K gives R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.5×0.751×1.46×10⁻⁴ ≈ 11 nΩ; T = 4.2 K gives ≈ 2×10⁻⁴×0.238×0.751×0.0149 ≈ 530 nΩ. Adding R_res = 5 nΩ, R_s at 2 K is ≈ 16 nΩ and Q₀ = 270/16×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.7×10¹⁰, while at 4.2 K Q₀ falls to about 5×10⁸.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀", which statement holds?
options: 鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。
Q₀ 是腔的固定常數，量一次低場值就夠了。

Q₀ is a fixed constant of the cavity, so one low-field measurement suffices.
A cavity that passed the vertical test will perform identically inside the module.
quiz.explanation: 鈮的表面電阻常用近似式 R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω（溫度 T 以 K 計）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A common approximation is R_BCS ≈ 2×10⁻⁴·(1/T)·(f/1.5 GHz)²·exp(−17.67/T) Ω with T in kelvin. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res；再與材料與處理紀錄比對是否符合 ≤ 5 nΩ 的殘餘電阻目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale. The slope yields the gap Δ/k_B and the intercept at 1/T → 0 yields R_res, which is then compared with the ≤ 5 nΩ residual target for the material and treatment lot. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the ambient field is not shielded below about 1 µT when cooling through 9.25 K, flux is pinned in the wall; each microtesla adds roughly 0.3 to 1 nΩ of residual resistance, Q₀ falls well below the BCS prediction, and no further cooling helps until the cavity is warmed above T_c and re-cooled.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res；再與材料與處理紀錄比對是否符合 ≤ 5 nΩ 的殘餘電阻目標。
knowledge.textEn: During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale. The slope yields the gap Δ/k_B and the intercept at 1/T → 0 yields R_res, which is then compared with the ≤ 5 nΩ residual target for the material and treatment lot.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res。
腔體最高梯度就是它在加速器中的運轉梯度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale.
A cavity's maximum gradient is the gradient it will run at in the accelerator.
quiz.explanation: 在垂直測試中由 4.2 K 緩慢降溫到 1.6 K，每隔 0.2 K 量一次低場 Q₀，畫 R_s = G/Q₀ 對 1/T 的半對數圖：斜率給出能隙 Δ/k_B，1/T → 0 的截距給出 R_res；再與材料與處理紀錄比對是否符合 ≤ 5 nΩ 的殘餘電阻目標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During the vertical test cool slowly from 4.2 K to 1.6 K and record low-field Q₀ every 0.2 K; plot R_s = G/Q₀ against 1/T on a semi-log scale. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「BCS 表面電阻與殘餘電阻」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “BCS surface resistance and residual resistance” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the ambient field is not shielded below about 1 µT when cooling through 9.25 K, flux is pinned in the wall; each microtesla adds roughly 0.3 to 1 nΩ of residual resistance, Q₀ falls well below the BCS prediction, and no further cooling helps until the cavity is warmed above T_c and re-cooled. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：品質因數 Q₀ = G/R_s，G 是只由腔形決定的幾何因子，TESLA 腔形 G ≈ 270 Ω。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The quality factor is Q₀ = G/R_s, with G a geometry factor fixed only by the cell shape, about 270 Ω for the TESLA shape.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要溫度低於臨界溫度，表面電阻就是零。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Below the critical temperature the surface resistance is exactly zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。
knowledge.textEn: If the ambient field is not shielded below about 1 µT when cooling through 9.25 K, flux is pinned in the wall; each microtesla adds roughly 0.3 to 1 nΩ of residual resistance, Q₀ falls well below the BCS prediction, and no further cooling helps until the cavity is warmed above T_c and re-cooled.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「表面電阻、幾何因子與 Q₀ 的溫度依存」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surface resistance, geometry factor and the temperature dependence of Q₀" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
鈮越純越好只是為了提高臨界溫度。
降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Purer niobium matters only because it raises the critical temperature.
If the ambient field is not shielded below about 1 µT when cooling through 9.25 K, flux is pinned in the wall.
quiz.explanation: 降溫經過 9.25 K 時若環境磁場未屏蔽到 1 µT 以下，磁通被釘扎在腔壁，每 1 µT 大約增加 0.3 到 1 nΩ 的殘餘電阻，Q₀ 顯著低於 BCS 預測，且怎麼降溫都救不回來，只能回溫重冷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the ambient field is not shielded below about 1 µT when cooling through 9.25 K, flux is pinned in the wall; each microtesla adds roughly 0.3 to 1 nΩ of residual resistance, Q₀ falls well below the BCS prediction, and no further cooling helps until the cavity is warmed above T_c and re-cooled. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
